card.line: Aram was the highland region northeast of Israel toward the Euphrates, later led by Damascus. It was home to Jacob's flight and a kingdom David defeated.

moments.title: Balaam's oracle
moments.text: Balaam says Balak brought him from Aram to curse Israel. Balaam answers that he cannot curse those whom God has not cursed.

moments.title: David rules Aram of Damascus
moments.text: David places garrisons in Aram of Damascus. The Arameans become his subjects and bring him tribute, and the LORD makes David victorious wherever he goes.

moments.title: Absalom's vow in Geshur
moments.text: Absalom tells David he made a vow while living in Geshur of Aram. He uses the vow as his reason to go to Hebron.

moments.title: Jacob flees to Aram
moments.text: Hosea recalls that Jacob fled to the land of Aram. There Israel worked for a wife and tended sheep for her.
